svg.title: Seven-stage high-load FTE-to-carbon scenario fan
svg.text: One engineer-day · 40 equal-effort candidate work units · three attempted FTE allocations carried through the same seven-stage model
Thin paths: sampled Monte Carlo days
Model: N ~ Binomial(A,q); attempted FTE/day = N/A; total tokens = sum of N sessions (median 1.4M/session).
H100 benchmark: 1,642 tokens/s, 326 W; facility kWh = GPU-s × W × host factor × PUE / 3.6M; CO₂e = kWh × U.S. source-mix factor.
Stage ribbons follow marginal P10–P90; thin paths are sampled days. Their vertical placement is schematic because stage units differ.
Equal human effort and one session per delegated unit are assumptions. Attempted FTE is not verified net labor replacement.
Energy is a Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B H100 proxy, not measured commercial-agent serving energy. IPCC median source factors; sampled U.S. mix.
Sources: Meyer et al. 2014; Standard Compute Agent Burn Index; local GPU tests; Guidi et al. 2026; EIA 2024; IPCC AR5. See REFERENCES.md.
